verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source runtime is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes Retell as a hosted, pay-as-you-go service reached through its dashboard, APIs, SDKs, CLI and MCP server, with no open-source runtime or self-hosted deployment documented. Bring-your-own telephony via SIP trunking connects your carrier to the hosted service and does not count as self-hosting the agent runtime.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
